updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Adaptive Scopes for SharePoint
updates.summary: DLP policies can now dynamically target SharePoint sites based on attributes like URL, name, or custom metadata instead of requiring manual site lists. This eliminates the 100-site static policy limit and enables scalable, automated policy deployment that evolves as site properties change.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Content Preview in Alerts
updates.summary: Authorized users can now preview file content directly within Insider Risk Management alerts without creating a separate case, streamlining investigation workflows. This reduces friction when reviewing potentially risky activity and helps security teams respond faster to insider threats.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention – Support for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP policies can now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications such as Box and Google Workspace using existing Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This extends your compliance perimeter beyond Microsoft 365 to third-party SaaS platforms using the same classification engine.

updates.title: Sensitivity Labels – Auto-Labeling Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies now support non-Microsoft connected applications including Box and Google Workspace, enabling consistent data classification across your hybrid cloud environment. Admins can use the same classification engine and Defender for Cloud Apps connectors already deployed for Microsoft 365.

updates.title: Sensitivity Labels – Simulation Mode for Auto-Labeling Policies
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode before enforcement, allowing admins to preview which items would be labeled and review match results without making changes. This reduces risk of misconfiguration and helps validate policy behavior before full rollout.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention – Reduced Policy Sync SLA to 30 Minutes
updates.summary: DLP policy updates now sync across the organization in 30 minutes instead of up to 2 hours, ensuring protections take effect more quickly. This improvement reduces the window where policy changes have not yet propagated to all endpoints.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention – Policy Tips in Outlook for Mac
updates.summary: Users on macOS now receive real-time DLP policy tip notifications in Outlook when composing emails with sensitive data that violates policies. They can remove non-compliant recipients or override the policy before sending, extending compliance protection to the Mac user base.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention – Policy Tips in Outlook Mobile
updates.summary: Outlook Mobile now displays DLP policy tips to alert users in real-time when drafting messages with sensitive information that violates organizational policies. This extends data loss prevention to mobile users and helps prevent accidental oversharing.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention – Safeguard Sensitive Data in Microsoft 365 Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: DLP now prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches, mitigating data leakage and oversharing risks. This protection ensures that classified or confidential information stays internal even when users leverage AI assistants.

updates.title: Data Security Investigations – Integration with Endpoint DLP Alerts
updates.summary: Admins can now launch Data Security Investigations directly from endpoint DLP alerts to analyze exfiltrated files, automatically gathering related content that triggered violations. This streamlines the investigation workflow by connecting alert detection to forensic analysis in a single interface.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Admins can now add file archiving actions to SharePoint retention policies, allowing inactive content to move to low-cost storage while remaining discoverable. This extends retention lifecycle management beyond keep-or-delete decisions, lowering storage costs without sacrificing compliance or search capability.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management – Hard Delete via Secure Priority Cleanup for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Admins can now configure retention policies and labels to hard delete content from OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows. This provides a controlled deletion path for compliance requirements while maintaining safeguards against inadvertent data loss.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Microsoft 365 Copilot Memory
updates.summary: Organizations can now configure retention policies for Copilot memory items stored in hidden Exchange mailboxes, preserving historical versions for security and compliance investigations. This enables admins to maintain visibility into memory changes while active memory continues to be managed by Copilot.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager – AI-Powered Regulatory Templates
updates.summary: Compliance Manager can now convert complex regulations from PDF documents into actionable controls and actions in multi-cloud environments. This AI-driven capability accelerates assessment creation and helps organizations identify compliance gaps more efficiently across diverse platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager – Integration with Microsoft Foundry for AI Agents
updates.summary: Compliance Manager now integrates with Microsoft AI Foundry to automatically assess the compliance posture of agents created in the platform. Organizations can map agents to compliance regulations and get real-time improvement actions, bridging AI development and compliance governance.
